title: A Must Own - An Invaluable Resource for Everyone!
content: This book is an outstanding resource for all parents, family members, teachers, mental health professionals, clergy, + anyone who works with kids or wants to understand how the brain works and how to nurture a developing brain. While it is addressed to parents, I have used it with adults in my mental health counseling practice to learn about the left and right brain and the upstairs and downstairs brains. It's empowering and liberating.

title: Highly recommend
content: Extra info for my Trauma informed parenting class. . .
